data.name: Filza
data.gender_notes: Filza is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Filza is an Arabic name that symbolizes a precious pearl, conveying beauty and purity. In Islamic tradition, it is considered a blessing to have a child with this name. The name Filza carries the meaning “Precious Pearl” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Filza usually hope their child will grow to embody precious pearl and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Quran, pearls are mentioned as a symbol of paradise (Surah Al-Rahman, 55:22).
data.etymology: Filza belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Precious Pearl.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Filza total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: فيلزة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم فيلزة يعني الحماية أو الغلاف أو الورق المقوى
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فيلزة مشتق من الجذر الفعلي 'فيلز' والذي يعني التغليف أو الحماية. في بعض المراجع، يرتبط بالورق المقوى أو الغلاف. اسم فيلزة ليس شائعًا في القرآن أو السنة النبوية، لكنه يبقى ذا معنى جميل في اللغة العربية، حيث يعبر عن الحماية أو التغليف، مما يجعله اسمًا جذابًا للإناث في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: فیلزہ
in_urdu.meaning: فیلزہ کا مطلب ہے حفاظت یا احاطہ کرنا
in_urdu.long_meaning: فیلزہ نام عربی زبان کی اصطلاحات سے ماخوذ ہے، جہاں اس کا مطلب ہوتا ہے حفاظت کرنا یا کسی چیز کو احاطہ کرنا۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں خوبصورتی اور حفاظت کی علامت کے طور پر استعمال ہوتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फिल्ज़ा
in_hindi.meaning: फिल्ज़ा का अर्थ है सुरक्षा या संरक्षण
in_hindi.long_meaning: फिल्ज़ा नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है सुरक्षा प्रदान करना या किसी चीज़ को ढकना। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में सुंदरता और सुरक्षा के प्रतीक के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: فیلزې
in_pashto.meaning: فیلزې د حفاظت یا پوښښ معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: فیلزې نوم د عربي ژبې له اصطلاحاتو څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چیرې چې د هغې معنی د حفاظت یا پوښښ څخه عبارت دی. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون قومونو په دودیزو نومونو کې کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: Filza

The name signifies safety, security, and care, reflecting positive personality traits.

It also signifies a strong connection with nature, as a pearl is formed naturally from the sea and is highly valued for its extraordinary beauty. This name can be a source of pride for families and communities, and can inspire children to strive towards achieving and upholding precious qualities.
data.spiritual_significance: Filza holds significant spiritual value in Islamic tradition due to its symbolism of a precious pearl. It represents the idea that the value of something lies not only in its physical appearance but also in its inner qualities, just as a pearl exists within an oyster shell. This name reminds us of the importance of cultivating inner beauty and spiritual purity, and to strive towards becoming precious pearls in the sight of God. The name also evokes the idea of patience and perseverance, as a pearl takes time to form and mature, and can be a source of inspiration for individuals seeking to improve themselves spiritually and emotionally.
